Job Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QA Engineer — Shopify Platform (Weekday Rotation) based in Netherlands.

This role is responsible for maintaining the quality, stability, and performance of a high-volume Shopify commerce platform during weekday evening or overnight hours.

You will provide continuous QA coverage across storefront, checkout, subscriptions, payments, themes, and third-party integrations.

The position combines real-time production monitoring with structured manual and automated testing of new releases and platform changes.

You will play a critical role in identifying customer-facing and revenue-impacting issues before they affect the wider business.

Working closely with developers, you will document defects, validate fixes, participate in release reviews, and escalate urgent issues when required.

Because the role operates outside standard daytime hours, strong ownership, independent decision-making, and proactive asynchronous communication are essential.

You will also maintain clear shift handoffs to ensure uninterrupted QA coverage and a consistent view of platform health across the full week.

Accountabilities

Monitor the live Shopify storefront throughout the assigned shift, identifying functional bugs, broken experiences, visual regressions, and other issues that could affect customers.
Validate deployments, theme updates, Liquid template changes, and third-party app integrations before and after release, including performing smoke tests following production deployments.
Execute end-to-end manual and automated regression testing across desktop and mobile experiences, covering checkout, subscriptions, subscription disclosures, discount codes, and payment processing.
Write and maintain structured test cases while performing cross-browser and cross-device validation using tools such as BrowserStack.
Triage and document defects in ClickUp and GitHub Issues with clear reproduction steps, supporting screenshots or videos, severity classifications, and relevant technical context.
Collaborate directly with developers through GitHub issues and pull-request review comments, helping identify potential root causes and validating fixes.
Perform targeted checks of third-party Shopify applications to identify conflicts or unexpected behavior and escalate customer-facing or revenue-impacting incidents according to established on-call procedures.
Prepare thorough shift handoff notes at the beginning and end of each coverage window so open issues, risks, and priorities are communicated clearly between teams.
Respond promptly to automated uptime and platform alerts and maintain reliable coverage throughout the assigned Monday–Friday EST schedule.

Requirements

5+ years of professional experience in QA, software testing, or a closely related discipline, ideally within a fast-paced agency, e-commerce business, or high-growth direct-to-consumer environment.
Strong hands-on knowledge of the Shopify ecosystem, including Shopify Admin, themes, apps, metafields, and storefront architecture.
Proficiency with Shopify Liquid and the ability to read and understand template logic to investigate defects and identify potential causes.
Practical experience working with GitHub, including branches, pull requests, diffs, issue tracking, and code-review discussions.
Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with enough technical depth to investigate storefront issues and communicate effectively with developers.
Experience writing structured manual test cases, conducting regression testing, triaging defects, assigning severity, and validating issues across browsers and devices.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly through asynchronous bug reports, handoff documentation, and developer discussions.
Strong attention to detail and a rigorous approach to quality, particularly when testing customer-facing and revenue-critical commerce flows.
Ability to work independently during evening or overnight hours with minimal supervision, while proactively communicating risks, blockers, and incidents.
Experience with subscription commerce platforms such as Recharge, Skio, or Loop is a plus.
Familiarity with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium is advantageous.
Experience with Shopify's theme editor and Online Store 2.0 sections and blocks is beneficial.
Exposure to conversion-rate optimization, Core Web Vitals, site-speed monitoring, GA4, or Shopify Analytics is a plus.

Benefits

Full-time contract position with a standard 30-day trial period before permanent confirmation.
Choice of a consistent Monday–Friday weekday rotation: 5:00 PM–1:00 AM EST or 1:00 AM–9:00 AM EST.
Opportunity to work in a dedicated QA function providing continuous coverage for a Shopify commerce platform.
High level of ownership and autonomy, with the opportunity to directly influence storefront reliability, customer experience, and revenue protection.
Direct collaboration with senior developers and clear escalation paths for production issues.
Structured shift handoffs and asynchronous workflows designed to support continuous operations across coverage windows.
Exposure to Shopify, subscription commerce, third-party integrations, release validation, and both manual and automated QA practices.
Performance-focused environment centered on rapid experimentation, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.
Inclusive and equal-opportunity working environment where qualified candidates are considered based on their skills and experience.
Developer-led production releases, with QA responsible for identifying, documenting, and escalating issues before or after deployment.

Job Description:
About Marktplaats

Marktplaats is one of the Netherlands' leading online marketplaces, helping make commerce more sustainable by giving products an extended life. With over 2.1 million buyers and sellers visiting our platform every day, around 350,000 new listings added daily and users spending an average of 22 minutes per visit, we're building a platform that people use and trust. Every connection we enable helps people save money, earn money and reduce waste. As part of Adevinta, one of Europe's leading online classifieds groups, we're building products that make buying and selling second-hand products simpler, safer and better for everyone.

This role sits within our Product & Technology function in our Amsterdam office, home to over 300 talented professionals, where cross-functional teams design, develop and scale the products that millions of users rely on every day across our Benelux marketplaces, Marktplaats and 2dehands/2ememain. This role is on the internal IT side of that function, building the platforms and automation the whole company runs on.

You'll own the IT infrastructure, SaaS ecosystem, identity and access management, and automation for ~350 colleagues, reducing manual work, optimising processes, and building a setup that scales without adding complexity. This is a hands-on role: we want IT here to work like engineering, not a support desk. AI is changing what a small IT team can do and we want to be at the front of that, not catching up. Today that means Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot, and you'll constantly be asking where AI can take work off our plate next.

You'll join our newly formed BNL IT team of four, reporting to the Head of IT. You'll work most closely with our Service Delivery Lead, and you'll be the first dedicated platform and automation engineer here, so you help decide how this works rather than inheriting it.

Build automated workflows and integrations across our systems
Write scripts and tooling to replace manual steps
Design, run and improve the infrastructure our teams use to ship the things they build with AI

Manage our cloud infrastructure and apply infrastructure-as-code
Own the SaaS ecosystem end to end: configuration, lifecycle and integrations
Own our AI tooling, steer where it goes next, and watch what it costs
Keep backup, restore and monitoring in place and tested

Identity and access

Design and maintain joiner/mover/leaver workflows

Act as escalation point for complex technical issues, working closely with Service Delivery
Manage vendor escalations and SLA oversight, and support onboarding of new toolsWho You Are

Als Automation Consultant bij The Public Network werk je aan oplossingen die processen transformeren en organisaties toekomstbestendig maken.

Waarom wij?

Wij zijn een kennisorganisatie: kennis is ons product. The Public Network (TPN) biedt jou, in samenwerking met onze partner MvR Digital Workforce (DW), de kans om impactvolle automation-projecten te draaien. Dat kan zijn bij de lokale overheid, denk aan gemeenten als Utrecht en Eindhoven, UWV, IND en DUO, of bij toonaangevende internationale bedrijven, snelgroeiende mkb'ers, fintechs en ziekenhuizen. Samen met een team van energieke en deskundige collega's zet je slimme automatisering en innovatieve technologieën (RPA, AI, Data) in, zodat mensen zich kunnen richten op het werk dat er écht toe doet.

Kennisontwikkeling staat bij ons centraal. Je leert continu van collega's en krijgt volop ruimte voor persoonlijke en vakinhoudelijke groei, intervisie en het volgen van je eigen interesses, zodat je vooroploopt in een snel veranderend technologisch landschap. Zelfstandigheid en vrijheid zijn kernwaarden bij TPN: jij bepaalt grotendeels zelf hoe je jouw vak invult.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent een ervaren automation-specialist die klaar is voor de volgende stap: het managen van je eigen klanten en het begeleiden van talentvolle collega's op hun weg als developer of consultant. Met jouw diepgaande kennis help je organisaties die hun digitale transformatie willen versnellen — of ze nu net starten met intelligente automatisering, of al bezig zijn met het opzetten van een eigen Center of Excellence.
Je werkt zelfstandig, of in teamverband, bij de Rijksoverheid, gemeenten, bedrijven en organisaties.

Wat zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden?

Klanten zijn vaak zoekende als het gaat om de volgende stap in hun automatisering. Jij bent daarin hun adviseur: je brengt structuur aan in hun vraag, en samen met jou bieden wij de oplossing.

Je brengt klanten van pilot naar een eigen Center of Excellence, passend bij onze visie dat klanten automation zelf ter hand nemen — of je sluit aan als onderdeel van het automation-team van een klant
Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de klant, voert intakegesprekken met de IT-afdeling en houdt oog voor de zachte kant van automation-implementaties
Samen met de klant bepaal je het plan van aanpak voor de korte termijn en de roadmap voor de lange termijn
Voor de uitvoering neem je een junior Automation Developer mee, die je coacht van procesintake tot go-live
Loop je tegen iets aan waar je extra expertise voor nodig hebt? Dan vallen we terug op elkaar: je collega-consultants staan voor je klaar

Hoe kom je in aanmerking voor de rol?

Je bent een ervaren Automation Developer. RPA is daarbij onze basis — of je die kennis nu hebt opgebouwd met UiPath, Power Automate of Blue Prism, maakt ons niet uit. Naast deze basis heb je de drive om te groeien in het AI-vakgebied en deze vaardigheid een plek te geven in automation-trajecten
Je hebt ongeveer 2 jaar ervaring als Automation Developer en voert zelfstandig automation-trajecten uit: van het voorbereiden van de techniek en de procesintake tot development, testen en go-live
Je hebt consultant DNA: je houdt van afwisseling, kunt goed omgaan met klanten — ook als het even tegenzit — en haalt energie uit het coachen van jongere collega's op inhoud en aanpak
Je bent bereid te reizen naar klanten door het land

Maar wat krijg jij er nou voor terug?

Onze voordelen reiken verder dan alleen werk; we bieden een podium voor voortdurende groei en de kans om jouw expertise in te zetten voor impactvolle projecten, terwijl je organisaties helpt om toekomstbestendig te worden. Ben jij klaar om het verschil te maken?

Help integrate, test and troubleshoot VoLTE, IMS and 4G/5G Core network solutions in real customer environments.

Investigate technical issues using logs, traces, alarms, KPIs and test results and work with the team to find the root cause.

Help configure, upgrade, migrate and expand network solutions while making sure services continue running smoothly.
Work with technologies and protocols such as SIP, Diameter, IP networking, Linux, DNS/ENUM and HTTP/2, depending on your experience.
Collaborate with engineers, solution architects, project managers, customers and other technical teams to solve problems and deliver projects successfully.
Document your work and share what you learn with the wider team.
Build your knowledge of cloud-native telecom and 5G Standalone (5G SA) technologies as our networks continue to evolve.
As your experience grows, take greater ownership of technical activities, customer communication, planning and solution design.

What You Bring

You don’t need to know everything on day one. We’re looking for people who are curious, enjoy solving technical problems and want to keep learning.

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field — or equivalent practical experience.

A logical approach to troubleshooting: you enjoy understanding why something isn’t working and figuring out how to fix it.
Curiosity and confidence to ask questions when you don’t know something.
Good communication skills and the ability to work with different teams and customers.
A collaborative mindset - you’re happy to learn from others and share what you know.
Fluent written and spoken English.
Willingness to work regularly from the customer testing facility approximately 30 km from Maastricht, as hands-on customer-site testing is an important part of this role.

De rol

Als Werkstudent CPE Tester ondersteun je het team door gestructureerde tests uit te voeren op devices en home networking setups. Je hoeft nog geen expert te zijn, maar je hebt wel technische interesse, werkt zorgvuldig en bent bereid om snel te leren.

Het installeren en configureren van devices zoals routers, modems en Wi-Fi access points.
Het uitvoeren van reboots en firmwarevalidaties.
Het controleren van GUI’s, parameters en device-instellingen.
Het verbinden en valideren van client devices.
Het aanpassen van wachtwoorden of configuraties.
Het uitvoeren van stabiliteits- en performancetests.
Het van begin tot eind volgen van vooraf gedefinieerde testscenario’s.
Het helder vastleggen van teststappen, resultaten, screenshots en issues.
Het signaleren van inconsistenties, onverwacht gedrag of afwijkingen van de verwachte uitkomst.
Het escaleren van issues wanneer nodig, op basis van een logische analyse van wat er is gebeurd.


Deze rol is sterk gericht op uitvoering. Nauwkeurigheid, consistentie en documentatie zijn daarom erg belangrijk. Na je onboarding is het doel dat je tests met minimale begeleiding kunt uitvoeren en betrouwbare, herhaalbare resultaten oplevert.

Interesse in automation of scripting, bijvoorbeeld Python of Bash.
Het vermogen om ideeën aan te dragen voor test automation, procesverbeteringen of AI-assisted validation.
Basisbegrip van hoe repeterend werk gestroomlijnd of gedigitaliseerd kan worden.
Lab- of stage-ervaring binnen IT of networking.

Je past goed bij Odido als je nieuwsgierig en betrouwbaar bent en je comfortabel voelt in een veranderende technische omgeving. Je hoeft nog niet alles te weten, maar je wilt wel graag leren, werkt zorgvuldig en bent gemotiveerd om te begrijpen hoe technologie zich in de praktijk gedraagt.
